text: ＊は　＊を　おぼえずに　おわった！

patterns.name: 〜ずに
patterns.explanation: ずに after a verb means 'without doing it'. おぼえずに = 'without learning'.

patterns.name: 〜ずにおわる
patterns.span: おぼえずに　おわった
patterns.explanation: ずに with おわる says things ended and the action never happened. おぼえずに　おわった = 'ended up not learning it'.
